checks: Every model opens with its first operation clearly identified
Denied access never activates RAM and restores exactly when stepping backward
Paging refill returns from the page table to TLB, then reads RAM back to CPU
A warm TLB hit skips the page table and connects TLB directly to address formation
Demand paging reverses the data direction between dirty write-back and page-in
FIFO emphasizes the oldest load while selection still leaves the old page in RAM
Clock shows the inspected frame, then moves the hand without replacing a page
Light/dark, resize and reduced motion retain destinations and snapshots
Automated WCAG A/AA checks cover highlighted operations in both themes
